# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_RIBBON_ALIGN_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the opening range breaks above its high and price stays above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon alignment (EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21), the intraday bullish bias tends to persist. Entering on the initial break with volume confirmation avoids waiting for a pullback, capturing stronger momentum in trending regimes while avoiding false breakouts that fail to hold above VWAP.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At the close of a 5-minute bar where: price > ORB_high (opening range high), price > VWAP, EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21, and volume > 1.5x the average volume of the first 5-minute bars of the day.  
**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: chart stop at ORB_low (structure invalidation if price closes below ORB_low on a 5-minute bar).  
- Profit-taking: TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward) from entry, then trail the runner at 15% off the high-water mark (HWM) after TP1 fills.  
**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX < 18 and time is between 09:45-11:30 ET, and price has been above VWAP for >60% of prior 5-minute bars (trending day confirmation).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈14% of headline P&L due to 50% per-trade risk cap and min 3-contract floor.  
2. **Sample bias:** Zero historical backtest performed; proposal based solely on price action theory. High overfit risk due to untested parameters (VIX threshold, time window, volume multiplier, EMA ribbon definition).  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic simulation of bid/ask slippage or fill probability on OPRA data).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: whipsaw breakout that reverses below ORB_low within same bar, triggering stop at entry bar close.  
   - Max drawdown: consecutive false breakouts in choppy markets (VIX > 20) could yield -$500/day at max size.  
   - Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion (VIX spike > 30) after entry causing gap-through ORB_low stop with slippage > 50% of premium.  
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top 5 days dominate P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

Needs a Stage-1 backtest via the autoresearch grinder harness before any further ratification. Must include:  
- Equity curve over full 16-month OPRA dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18).  
- Walk-forward OOS/IS Sharpe ratio ≥ 0.70.  
- Sub-window stability (no single quarter < -$200).  
- Anchor no-regression test (edge_capture ≥ 0 on J days).  
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days (diff < ±20% vs BS sim).  
- Concentration disclosure (top5_pct ≤ 200%).
